topic: Someone discovers their neighbor is secretly wealthy
text: I've been watching ol' Gregor, seen him toil just like the rest of us. Thought he was just another under the thumb of the lord, fists buried in the same hard earth. But the whispers go 'round that his barn's fattened with more than just hay and a few sickly goats. Fine fabrics and plates of silver, they say. How is it that he's been hiding such wealth, while the rest of us face the bailiff's frown over a few bushels of grain? The saints must have turned their eyes elsewhere, for in our village, fairness seems as scarce as rain in summer's drought. I just hope his fortune doesn’t bring the lord’s attention, less we all find our burdens heavier.
